title: Assurance backstage notes (SOC2 prep)
content:
Purpose:
Quick running notes for mapping evidence + micro-controls for SOC2 readiness. Not a formal runbook. Use as a personal checklist and handoff skeleton for SEs and SREs when we collect artifacts.

Context:
- Focus: Redwood Private installs (VPC + on-prem) + Dedicated (reserved capacity) where customers ask for SOC2 artifacts.
- We have hosted API baseline docs but Private has gaps around configuration proof, KMS integration evidence, and network segmentation screenshots.
- Goal in next 6 weeks: produce a minimal evidence pack that satisfies auditors for common Trust Service Criteria (security, availability, confidentiality).

Quick evidence map (working):
- Logical access control: list of IAM roles + policy snapshots (JSON) + time-stamped export from cloud IAM (s3/gs). Owner: Isha.
- Privileged access reviews: HR attestation + last 2 quarters review notes (Confluence page). Owner: Ravi.
- Deployment pipeline integrity: GitHub PR -> CI logs -> signed artifact hashes (artifact registry). Need to capture example PRs and matched build logs. Owner: Felix.
- KMS / key lifecycle: KMS CMK creation date + rotation policy screenshot + KMS access audit (CloudTrail). For on-prem HSM, get HSM inventory + HSM access log sample. Owner: Maya.
- Network controls: VPC/subnet diagrams, firewall rule export, vpn/peering docs, bastion usage logs. Need to confirm: do we have automated exports for Dedicated customers? Action: check infra-ops runbook.
- Backup & recovery: snapshot cadence, test restore runbook, one successful restore run result. Owner: Platform Eng contact TBD.
- Monitoring & alerting: example SLOs, alert routing playbook, PagerDuty escalation policy export.

Open questions / unknowns (prioritize):
1) For Private installs, do we generate a single canonical evidence bundle per customer or per release? (Pros/cons: per-customer is heavier) -> action: propose per-customer snapshot at onboarding + quarterly updates.
2) Is there an automated way to pull KMS access logs without manual console exports for on-prem HSM? (Ravi to check with infra ops).
3) Can we standardize naming for artifacts in artifact registry to make auditor pathing trivial? -> quick win: add naming template to onboarding checklist.
4) Which metrics do auditors usually expect for availability? uptime %, MTTR examples, incident postmortem sample. We have uptime dashboards but need formalized one-pager.

Draft control wording (very rough) — to iterate with legal/audit:
- "Access to production systems is limited to authorized personnel and managed through role-based access controls. Privileged access is reviewed quarterly and revoked when not required."
- "Customer data at rest in Private deployments is encrypted with customer-isolated keys managed via KMS/HSM and access is logged for audit."

Evidence artifacts to collect (examples):
- IAM policy JSON exports (timestamped)
- Example admin-account login session audit (CloudTrail)
- One signed build artifact + CI logs showing step-by-step build -> deploy
- KMS key metadata (ARN), rotation policy file, access audit snippet
- Network ACL / firewall rules CSV export
- Backup manifest + restore test runbook notes
- Incident postmortem (redacted) showing MTTR and RCA (last 12 months)

Notes on Dedicated vs Private differences:
- Dedicated: still within our cloud accounts so easier to produce cloud-native logs, but need to show tenant isolation (compute pools + tagging).
- Private: customer-controlled networking, need onboarding checklist to capture customer-provided evidence and confirm our install steps (we can't access their logs by default).

Immediate next actions (short list):
- [ ] Draft evidence-bundle template (zip layout + manifest.json) — target Mar 14. Owner: Felix.
- [ ] Confirm KMS log extraction for on-prem HSM (ask infra-ops, ticket SEC-312) — Owner: Ravi — due Mar 9.
- [ ] Inventory of recent PRs/builds that can serve as CI->deploy examples — Owner: Felix — due Mar 10.
- [ ] Reach out to two pilot customers to request consent for sample evidence from their Private install (anonymized) — Owner: Maya — due Mar 17.

Parking lot / ideas:
- Lightweight auditor portal where we can upload time-limited artefacts per customer. MVP could be a signed S3 pre-signed URL zip.
- Small CLI tool to bundle artifacts by template (iam-export, cloudtrail-slice, kms-metadata) — low effort snack.

Handy refs / links I keep needing:
- Confluence: "SOC2 Pack Template" (link above)
- Jira: SEC-312 (evidence automation), PROD-911 (backup restore test ticket), ENGOPS-204 (bastion access hardening)
- Slack threads: #trust-ops "audit readiness" (search ts:1687602345)

Draft communication to SEs (copy idea):
"Hi team — trying to standardize what auditors want for Private installs. If you own installs, please snapshot these 6 artifacts and drop into the evidence template by next week. I'll provide a CLI helper and a short video walkthrough. Thanks — Felix"

Random scratch ideas (brain dump):
- Could we add a checkbox in the installer that exports a one-time evidence bundle (post-install)? makes audit onboarding trivial.
- Consider a short LLM-driven checklist generator that asks: "Which artifacts do you have?" and spits out the manifest. Might be useful for 1st pass.

End of notes. Keep this doc light — I'll extract formal items into Confluence once we have consensus.
summary: Personal draft for SOC2 evidence mapping and quick actions focused on Private + Dedicated installs, with open questions and immediate owners.
